review:
Cash Patrol is a fast-paced 5x3 cop-and-robber slot packed with collect features. Money, fast cars, handcuffs and doughnuts fill the reels, and the bonus includes money collects, expanding wilds and extra collects, plus big rewards when the police put a criminal behind bars.

The feature that defines the game comes at the end of free spins: one final bust can award a large reward if it succeeds, so the round builds towards a climax. In-game information advertises up to 10,500x. The RTP is 96.5%. It's an entertaining money-collect slot with a theme that's lighter than most.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
